name: Dunemaul Dues
summary: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port wants a shiny bangle recovered near the Dunemaul ogre compound. It was lost when a merchant caravan threw cargo to distract the ogres.

sections.title: Lost Cargo
sections.body: A caravan lost cargo near the Dunemaul ogre compound after the ogres attacked. Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port asks you to recover a particularly shiny bangle. The merchants are pressing him over their lost profits, and he offers to make it worth your trouble.

faq.answer: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port wants you to recover the shiny bangle.
The bangle was lost near the Dunemaul ogre compound.

faq.q: How did the caravan lose its cargo?
faq.answer: The caravan took a wrong turn through the desert and was attacked by Dunemaul ogres. Its people threw cargo overboard to distract them.

faq.q: Why does Bilgewhizzle want it recovered?
faq.answer: The merchants are pressing Bilgewhizzle over the profits lost with their cargo.

faq.q: What kind of bangle is Bilgewhizzle looking for?
faq.answer: Bilgewhizzle asks for a particularly shiny bangle bracelet.
